body: I can attest that you can, and would recommand focusing on gettign 50 stones so that you can build a wayvessel, which will allow you to visit other people's wayvessel. This will open the world a bit more while still staying at home

author: Zickiusky
body:
Seeing how I am 245 by mostly playing at my house, I can guarantee you'll be fine farming and grinding at home. 
Get the stones for the WV 
Get alot of materials to make shops and buy out everything and then disasemble them for material you'll be rich in mats in no time. Welcome to Orna =D

author: anugosh
body:
You sure can. Mobs will respawn as you kill them, so no worries there.

See if there are dungeons near you, that you might be able reliably farm without leaving the house, in addition to the one you can do every hours from the menu. Don't hesitate to buy torches from shops to increase your sight at night

author: Altern4tive01
body: Join a kingdom fie kingdom raids, that will give you a good amount of xp. Also join the orna legends discoed channel, there are alot of people doing xp parties and sharing dungeons that will help alot

author: So_Numb13
body:
Yup, I'd say I'm playing at least 80% from home. It might be a little slower at the start but once you get enough resources to builld your own town, you'll catch up. 

Try finding players to join you in a party, so you can travel to their towns.

You won't be able to do the fights for territories and lose a bit on exploration, but these are just other ways to get rewards and xp, you won't be blocked in your general progress.

author: TwinMugsy
body: Totally can. I would recommend joining a guild and getting on a few discords. Finding a few parties you can join for doing gauntlets/finding npcs you need/bosses you need for quests it really helps. I reccomend finding a beginners guide because there is a lot of neat tricks that can help a lot early :) like... use any arena tokens you get early (in your initi menu screen at the top) they help a lot with exp and you can luck out with neat loot.  Kill any mimics you see as they have neat and some times loot above their tier. There are lanterns and draconian arcstaffs for view distance by tier 3 and they help a lot playing from home as do torches the usable item in shops you shoulr virtually always have one on

author: [deleted]
body:
Honestly, the GPS component of the game is so minimal you can really just play from home. Very few quests actually require going out and about, and the ones that do you can just wait on them for the enemy you're looking for to just show up at your door.

Also, you get the vast majority of your XP from kingdom raids, not fighting monsters. So join a kingdom as soon as you can.

author: Scelusteach
body: You may also want to keep an eye out for gear that increases your view distance. That can help when playing from home.

author: NSA_Chatbot
body:
I play it mostly from my house and work, but I do pull it out when I'm travelling or on the bus, so I can claim extra territories.  

I'm definitely not gaining as fast as some other players who are following the optimal meta, but I'm still having fun. 

View distance gear is a HUGE asset.  I can get to an extra dungeon with all that extra gear on, and with the torch / farsight / brazier I can get almost a mile diameter.

author: Excellent_Return8645
body: Yes but you either need a good kingdom with a network of wayvessesls or a good area you can refresh every day. Like you probably want 6 or more dungeons and unfelled concords. If you find a good area you can make an alt and put the alts WV there and refresh it daily. You'll also want to get all the view distance gear you can find.
